title: Qsarify-Core — backend-only source
description: Backend-only prerelease source for QSARify: Flask API, services, jobs, tests, requirements, and additive Target Modeling Workspace V2 migrations. Excludes the frontend, production data, ChEMBL caches, user uploads, logs, runtime state, and serialized model artifacts. This prerelease is not a stable 1.0 API commitment.
